_about: Answer key for the Part 2 meeting series. Written BEFORE any pipeline code.

_conventions.mentions: What each meeting says about each task: the expected output of EXTRACTION for that meeting (stateless, one meeting at a time). Small talk and decisions not to act are not mentions.
_conventions.status: open (new or still to do) | done | cancelled
_conventions.owner: team member responsible (Sam, Priya, Tom, Jamie) as said or clearly implied in THIS meeting; null if nobody is named or implied
_conventions.owner_from_text: false when the owner is only knowable from WHO is speaking (we don't do speaker diarization). Measured separately.
_conventions.due: ISO date resolved from the meeting date; null if not said in THIS meeting. 'today'/'this afternoon' = meeting date, 'tomorrow' = +1 day, a weekday = that weekday in the meeting's week, 'end of the month' = last day of the month, a day of the month ('the thirtieth', 'the second') = the next such date on or after the meeting, 'at some point' = null. A start date ('starting Monday the twelfth') counts as the due date. If both a deadline and a promised date are said ('runs out on the fifteenth' + 'I'll do it this afternoon'), due = the promised date.
_conventions.tracker_after: Expected tracker state after each meeting = all mentions so far applied in order: a mention's non-null owner/due overwrite the task's values, its status always overwrites. Computed by answer_key.tracker_states(), so it can't drift from the mentions.
_conventions.match: How Phase 6 recognises a task in pipeline output (answer_key.matches): 'all' = every group must have at least one word in the task text (lowercase substring, so 'book' also matches 'booked'), 'none' = none of these words may appear. answer_key.problems() checks that each task's own text matches its own rule and no other.
